A return code field, which the plan lists for the run history. The CSV has Status and Records only, and scheduled time sits in a separate sheet.
A daily monitoring record covering the whole day (who monitored, when, and a note of 'no other failures'). The log is only an alert list.

attributes.note: For 2027-03-15, every failed run in the full-status export has a monitoring alert and an incident, and nothing contradicts. The gaps are the acknowledgement time, the return code, a whole-day monitoring record, and any other selected days. The files make no claim about audit conclusions.

missing: Only one day (2027-03-15) is covered. No evidence is provided for other selected days in the interim or roll-forward periods.

The rerun is evidenced only by the scheduler CSV and the incident text. No separate rerun log or reconciliation output is provided. The bank acknowledgement is only described in the incident.
The incident report does not name who investigated or closed each incident.
attributes.note: Evidence for 2027-03-15 covers both failures with investigation, resolution, rerun, recovery and closure, and nothing contradicts it. It is a single day. The auditor decides whether it is enough for the walkthrough and for the interim and roll-forward periods.
